summary: In web/src/lib/rcq.ts I added MAIN_SHARE = 0.02, made expectedOptions collect each key's label set and sum every row's share at the chosen tier (a multi-label key is named by its key, a single-label key by that label), and added splitOptions for main/other. In web/src/components/rcq/InputsCard.tsx I added the showOther state, rendered main plus shown/picked other options plus missing ones, and a chip-styled button reading 'Other (N)' or 'Fewer' with aria-expanded. In web/src/views/RcqView.tsx I dropped useMetagameStatus and the reset window, added CHIP_WINDOW_DAYS = 14 used as useMetaPresence({ days: CHIP_WINDOW_DAYS }), and rewrote the share note. All three check commands pass: pnpm --dir web test (527 tests), tsc -b, lint.
concerns: The 'Other (N)' count is the hidden tail count (other options not picked), so it shrinks as tail chips are picked; verify that matches intent.
splitOptions treats a null share as below MAIN_SHARE, so tier-unseen keys land under Other.
showOther is local to InputsCard and resets when the card remounts, e.g. on deck change.
